dash.framing: One instrument, many ways in: redesign your job or a workflow, X-ray a résumé or role, sharpen a decision, or negotiate — on your own, with a partner, or live with a cohort.

catalog.cohortOnly: Runs live in a cohort. Open your facilitator's cohort link to take part.

reimagine-job.name: Reimagine Your Job
reimagine-job.tagline: Interview a partner, then redesign each other's jobs with the 2×4 model — learn what only a human can lead, own, and judge, and what AI can take off your plate.

reimagine-workflow.name: Reimagine a Workflow
reimagine-workflow.tagline: Pick a real workflow and redraw it with a partner — learn to weigh AI's tradeoffs and put people and AI in the right seats, instead of just patching what you have.

benchmark.name: The Benchmark
benchmark.tagline: Take a timed reasoning test, then see your score against the whole room — and against AI on the same questions. An honest read on where humans still have the edge.

workflow-solo.name: Reimagine a Workflow with AI
workflow-solo.tagline: Describe a workflow and let AI interview you, then watch it redraw the flow — learn who should do what once AI and humans share the work, and leave with a redesign.

network.name: The Network
network.tagline: Map the room's real advice and friendship networks — live and anonymous — then see who's actually most central. A vivid lesson in how influence really flows.

jd-x-ray.name: Job Description X-ray
jd-x-ray.tagline: Paste a job description and see which tasks AI can do — then learn to rewrite the role as a human+AI job, and exactly who to hire for it.

career-x-ray.name: Career X-ray
career-x-ray.tagline: Paste your résumé and see which parts of your work AI can do — then learn the higher-value work to lean into, and where your career can go next.

solo-ai.name: Reimagine Your Job with AI
solo-ai.tagline: Let AI interview you to find your real job, then get a redesign that hands AI the busywork and keeps the judgment with you — and learn where you're most valuable.

execution-4a.name: 4A Execution Diagnostic
execution-4a.tagline: Pressure-test a real initiative against the 4 A's — Alignment, Ability, Architecture, Agility — and learn the single highest-leverage fix keeping it from executing.

close-the-offer.name: Close the Offer
close-the-offer.tagline: Negotiate a multi-issue job offer live against an AI hiring manager, then get scored on the value you claimed and created — and learn where you left money on the table.

name-your-price.name: Name Your Price
name-your-price.tagline: Haggle over a single price against an AI seller with a hidden floor — learn to anchor, hold your walk-away, and claim your share of the bargaining zone.

good-business.name: Is This a Good Business?
good-business.tagline: Pressure-test a business idea against real frameworks and real unit economics — learn whether the market is attractive, where your edge is durable, and what would have to be true to win.

balanced-scorecard.name: Balanced Scorecard
balanced-scorecard.tagline: Turn a strategy into objectives, measurable results, and initiatives across the four Balanced Scorecard perspectives — and learn how they link as one cause-and-effect chain.

ai-canvas.name: AI Opportunity Canvas
ai-canvas.tagline: Map one workflow to find where AI actually belongs — the human/AI split, the risks, and how to deploy it. You leave with an implementation-grade plan.

opportunity-capability.name: Opportunity–Capability Fit
opportunity-capability.tagline: Test an opportunity against what you can actually do — your Tasks, People, Systems, and Culture — and learn the one capability gap most likely to break the bet.

test-the-bet.name: Test-the-Bet
test-the-bet.tagline: Turn a strategic belief into a clean, runnable experiment — the hypothesis, the one metric that matters, and the decision rule — and learn to test a bet before you commit.
